lines.en: label mikudorm35:
I knock on Miku’s door and wait for her to answer, though I wouldn’t be surprised if she decides not to tonight.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Miku 的门，等她来应门——不过要是她今晚决定不开，我也不会太意外。

lines.en: The two of us haven’t really spent much time together ever since the...occurrence at the beach house, and I’m sure she’s feeling a little strange about it.
lines.zh: 自从海边小屋那次……事之后，我们俩就很少再待在一起了，我敢肯定她心里对此挺别扭的。

lines.en: I know I would be in her position.
lines.zh: 换作是她，我肯定也会这样。

lines.en: Thankfully, I’ve never had the misfortune of being in the position of a [teenage]girl and have much more experience either on top of or beneath them.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我从没遭过当一个[teenage]女孩这种罪，倒是更有经验待在她们的上面或者下面。

lines.en: But I digress.
lines.zh: 不过扯远了。

lines.en: The volume of Miku's TV inside of the room is turned down, the same way it has been several times before when I’ve visited this place.
lines.zh: 房间里 Miku 的电视音量被调小了，跟我之前几次来这儿时一模一样。

lines.en: So, the chances are she’s either about to invite me in-
lines.zh: 所以，她要么正准备邀我进去——

lines.en: Or peer through the door, see that it’s me, and then pretend to be asleep.
lines.zh: 要么从门缝里往外瞟一眼，发现是我，然后装睡。

lines.en: I knock again to let her know I’m onto her.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次，好让她知道我已经看穿了。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah?
She bites immediately.
lines.zh: 她立刻上钩了。

lines.en: : Hey. Are you free tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。今晚有空吗？

lines.en: : Um...yeah.
: You wanna like...go out for a walk or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 你想不想……出去走走什么的？

lines.en: : I think I’d prefer to hang out in there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还是想进去待着。

lines.en: : You sure? It’s...supposed to be really nice out right now!
lines.zh: : 你确定？外面现在……天气应该特别好啊！

lines.en: : It’s freezing. I was literally just outside.
lines.zh: : 冻死了。我刚刚人可就在外面。

lines.en: : Yeah yeah but like, what if it...isn’t anymore?!
lines.zh: : 好好好，可是万一它……现在不冷了呢？！

lines.en: : Just let me in, Miku.
lines.zh: : 让我进去吧，Miku。

lines.en: : Gaaaaah...fine! But only cause I feel bad for makin’ ya wait out in the hallway and stuff...
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊……行吧！但我只是不忍心让你在走廊里干等着啦……

lines.en: scene black
scene mikupostbeach1
: Uhh...
: So...how about that weather?
lines.zh: : 那个……今天天气还挺好的哈？

lines.en: : Is that just going to be your go-to topic for avoiding awkward conversation tonight or are you suddenly interested in becoming a meteorologist?
lines.zh: : 这是你今晚用来躲开尴尬对话的万能话题，还是你突然对当气象学家产生兴趣了？

lines.en: : The heck do meteors have to do with the weather?
lines.zh: : 流星跟天气有什么关系啊？

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Actually, never mind.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。

lines.en: : Is there something you want to talk about?
lines.zh: : 你有什么想跟我说的吗？

lines.en: : Well since we’re already on the topic of meteors-
lines.zh: : 既然我们都聊到流星了——

lines.en: : Miku.
lines.zh: : Miku。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach2
: Do we really have to talk about the thing that happened or can we just kinda...pretend it never did?
lines.zh: : 我们非得聊那件事不可吗？能不能就……当它没发生过？

lines.en: : Pretending it never happened means there will be less of a chance for it to happen again, so I’d like to avoid that if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 装作没发生过，就意味着它再次发生的概率会降低，所以我想尽量避免那样。

lines.en: : That’s...kinda why I think we should avoid it. I can’t be thinkin’ about that kinda stuff with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这……才是我觉得该避而不谈的原因。我没法跟你去想那种事，Sensei。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach3
: Cause you’re my friggin’ teacher, my soccer coach, and the guy my best friend obviously has the hots for!
lines.zh: : 因为你是我他妈的老师、我的足球教练，还是我闺蜜明显暗恋的那个人！

lines.en: : That’s a triple whammy, Sensei! I’ve gotta put myself on the bench for this one!
lines.zh: : 这可是三重暴击，Sensei！这一局我得把自己换下场！

lines.en: : Just take a seat on my lap instead. You’ve proven on two occasions now that you like it there.
lines.zh: : 那就改坐到我腿上吧。你已经两次证明了你喜欢那个位置。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach4
: Come on...
lines.zh: : 拜托……

lines.en: : I know I don’t act serious all that often cause like...I’m not good at actin’ like that...but I’m really trying right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道我不怎么正经，因为……我不太会装正经……但我现在真的很努力了。

lines.en: : There are some things you just shouldn’t do and I’m pretty sure that bumpin’ uglies with a triple whammy is one of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 有些事就是不该做，我很确定跟一个“三重暴击”乱搞就是其中之一。

lines.en: : And I already have a hard enough time with feelin’ all weird around you, so hearin’ stuff about sittin’ on your lap makes it like a billion times harder.
lines.zh: : 光是待在你身边我就够不自在了，再听你说什么坐你腿上，难度直接翻了十亿倍。

lines.en: : You feel weird because you like me, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你觉得别扭，是因为你喜欢我，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach5
: Well, yeah! That much should be obvious after the beach!
lines.zh: : 那当然！海边那次之后这不是明摆着嘛！

lines.en: : And even before that!
lines.zh: : 在那之前就喜欢了！

lines.en: : I started feelin’ that way about you a while ago...but it’s not like I ever saw myself hidin’ under the covers with you!
lines.zh: : 我老早就开始对你有那种感觉了……可我也从没想过自己会跟你一起躲在被子里啊！

lines.en: : I didn’t even know you were gonna be sleepin’ in that bed! The heck were ya thinkin’ gettin' all up in my space like that?!
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道你会睡在那张床上！你当时往我这边凑过来到底在想什么啊？！

lines.en: : That was actually Makoto’s idea, so we can probably just blame her for this entire ordeal.
lines.zh: : 那其实是 Makoto 的主意，所以这整档子事大概都能怪到她头上。

lines.en: : Why the heck would Makoto let ya sleep next to me?!
lines.zh: : Makoto 干嘛会答应让你睡我旁边啊？！

lines.en: : Because I promised to keep my hands to myself.
lines.zh: : 因为我答应了她会管好自己的手。

lines.en: : Which I actually did until...you know.
lines.zh: : 而我也确实做到了，直到……你知道的。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach6
: Aaaahhhh! Whose idea was it to invent hormones anyway?! They just make everythin’ harder!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！到底是谁想出荷尔蒙这破玩意儿的？！它只会让一切都变得更难！

lines.en: : I don’t know how many times you want me to say it, but I really don’t mind doing things like that with you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你要我说多少遍，但我真的不介意跟你做那种事。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach7
: Well yeah. Ya made that pretty obvious the first time you started puttin’ your hands where they don’t belong.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你第一次把手伸到不该伸的地方时，就已经表现得很明显了。

lines.en: : But I already told you, the two of us can’t do stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 可我说过了，我们俩不能做那种事。

lines.en: : Sure we can. Especially since you’re already aware that you actually like me and that it’s not entirely hormones.
lines.zh: : 当然能。尤其是你已经意识到自己是真喜欢我，而不全是荷尔蒙作祟。

lines.en: : I know I friggin’ like you, Sensei. Stop makin’ me say it.
lines.zh: : 我知道我他妈喜欢你，Sensei。别再逼我说出口了。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because it just friggin’ reminds me of how long my best friend has liked you compared to me.
lines.zh: : 因为那只会他妈地提醒我，我闺蜜喜欢你的时间比我久太多。

lines.en: : How long has Makoto liked me, Miku?
lines.zh: : Makoto 喜欢我多久了，Miku？

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach8
: I don’t know! Months? Years?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道！几个月？几年？

lines.en: : But you two have only been my students for a few months, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你们俩当我的学生才几个月吧？

lines.en: : Course not! If that’s true then how come-
lines.zh: : 才不是！如果真是这样，那为什么——

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach9
: Wait, what the heck?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么鬼？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s only been a few months.
lines.zh: : 是啊。才几个月而已。

lines.en: : Why’s it feel like so much longer?
lines.zh: : 可为什么感觉已经过了那么久？

lines.en: It appears we are now two-for-two.
lines.zh: 看来目前已经两发两中了。

lines.en: First, Makoto started to catch on to how strange the flow of time has gotten with three semesters of memories packed into one-
lines.zh: 先是 Makoto 开始察觉到时间流逝有多诡异——三个学期的记忆全被塞进了一个学期里——

lines.en: And now Miku is on that same exact train.
lines.zh: 现在 Miku 也踏上了同一趟列车。

lines.en: Pretty soon, everyone will be on board and the world will collapse.
lines.zh: 用不了多久，所有人都会上车，然后世界就会崩塌。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I imagine Maya would say.
lines.zh: 至少我猜 Maya 会这么说。

lines.en: But this simply can’t go on forever.
lines.zh: 但这终究不可能永远持续下去。

lines.en: Within a matter of time, someone is going to start piecing it together. And once they do, I’ll be able to talk about it without sounding like I’m absolutely insane.
lines.zh: 迟早会有人开始把这些碎片拼起来。一旦到了那一步，我就能把这事儿说出来，而不至于听起来像个彻头彻尾的疯子。

lines.en: For example, watch this-
lines.zh: 比如说，看好了——

lines.en: : Miku, what if I told you that the reason it feels like it’s been longer is because we’re stuck in a time loop?
lines.zh: : Miku，如果我告诉你，之所以感觉过了那么久，是因为我们被困在时间循环里了，你会怎么想？

lines.en: : A time what now? Have you been drinkin’ or something?
lines.zh: : 时间什么？你是不是喝多了？

lines.en: See?
lines.zh: 看到了吧？

lines.en: No one will believe me.
lines.zh: 没人会信我。

lines.en: Sometimes, you need to see the end of the world to accept that not everything is as it seems.
lines.zh: 有些时候，你得亲眼看见世界末日，才会接受“并非一切都像表面那样”。

lines.en: And I’m sure that same thing will apply to Miku, Makoto, and anyone else who begins to piece it all together.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，Miku、Makoto，以及任何开始把一切拼凑起来的人，都会是这样。

lines.en: Just like all of the girls I know, Kumon-mi is one big puzzle.
lines.zh: 就像我认识的所有女孩一样，Kumon-mi 也是一个巨大的谜题。

lines.en: So big that everyone has to work together to even fathom the chance of ever finishing it.
lines.zh: 大到所有人必须齐心协力，才敢想象有朝一日能把它拼完。

lines.en: But that’s enough thinking for now.
lines.zh: 不过现在想够了。

lines.en: There are more important things currently at stake.
lines.zh: 眼下还有更要紧的事。

lines.en: : Why does it matter what Makoto wants if it directly contradicts what you want?
lines.zh: : 如果 Makoto 想要的和你想要的完全相反，那她的想法又有什么要紧？

lines.en: : It matters cause Makoto is my best friend and wants to do all sorts of cute girly stuff with you like...takin’ out a mortgage or adopting a parrot.
lines.zh: : 要紧，因为 Makoto 是我最好的朋友，她想跟你做各种可爱的小女生的事，比如……办个房贷，或者领养一只鹦鹉。

lines.en: : You have a strange idea of what constitutes “girly.”
lines.zh: : 你对“小女生”的定义还真奇怪。

lines.en: : I’m a friggin’ tomboy, Sensei. Go talk to Ami if ya want to know about girly stuff.
lines.zh: : 我可是个彻头彻尾的假小子，Sensei。想了解小女生那套，去找 Ami 啊。

lines.en: : Fact is, Makoto wants to do stuff with you and my mind keeps gettin’ wrapped around on stuff I want you to do to me.
lines.zh: : 事实是，Makoto 想跟你做那些事，而我的脑子却一直缠在我想让你对我做的那些事上。

lines.en: : So...you like me, but you’re more interested in the physical aspect of it rather than something like growing old together and buying a house?
lines.zh: : 所以……你喜欢我，但你更在意的是身体那方面，而不是一起变老、买房子之类的？

lines.en: : Kinda, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，嗯。

lines.en: : This is the actual best news I’ve ever received.
lines.zh: : 这可是我收到过的最好的消息。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach10
: That’s not good news at all! I don’t know the first thing about that kinda stuff!
lines.zh: : 这根本不是什么好消息！那种事我一窍不通！

lines.en: : I mean...you definitely know at least something now.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你现在至少也知道一点了吧。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach11
: You’re really not makin’ this any easier on me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你真是半点都不让我好过，Sensei。

lines.en: : Good. It’s not supposed to be easy.
lines.zh: : 很好。这事儿本来就不该容易。

lines.en: : It’s good that you care so much about something that could hurt someone close to you.
lines.zh: : 你会在意一件可能伤到你亲近之人的事，这很好。

lines.en: : But it’s not good how you’re giving up what you want in favor of that.
lines.zh: : 但你为此放弃自己想要的东西，这就不好了。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to say this, but there are a lot more than just two people vying for my affection right now.
lines.zh: : 我想不用我说你也知道，现在争抢我的可不止你们两个人。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach12
: You’ve got half the friggin’ class ready to take off their skirts for ya.
lines.zh: : 全班有一半人都随时愿意为你把裙子脱下来。

lines.en: : And I’m sure they’ll all come off in due time.
lines.zh: : 而且我相信，时机到了它们都会脱下来的。

lines.en: : I’m not looking to take out a mortgage with Makoto or...adopt a bird or whatever it was you said.
lines.zh: : 我可没打算跟 Makoto 办房贷，也没打算……领养什么鸟，管你刚说的什么来着。

lines.en: : I just want to spend time with all of you and, if we both happen to want to do a little extra with that time, I have no issues with it whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 我只是想跟你们每个人待在一起，如果碰巧我们俩都想用那些时间多做一点什么，我完全没有意见。

lines.en: : But...I just keep thinkin’ of how all those girls would feel if they found out.
lines.zh: : 可是……我总在想，要是那些女孩知道了会怎么想。

lines.en: : How would you feel if you found out I was doing things with the other girls?
lines.zh: : 如果你发现我在跟别的女孩做那种事，你会怎么想？

lines.en: : Weird.
lines.zh: : 会很怪。

lines.en: : Don’t you already feel weird, though?
lines.zh: : 可你现在不就已经觉得很怪了吗？

lines.en: : I always feel weird when you’re around.
lines.zh: : 你在我身边的时候，我总是觉得很怪。

lines.en: : Because you like me.
lines.zh: : 因为你喜欢我。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach3
: Stop it with all that “like” business! I friggin’ know!
lines.zh: : 别再提什么“喜欢”了！我他妈知道！

lines.en: : So what then? Are you just going to avoid how you feel forever?
lines.zh: : 那然后呢？你打算就这么永远躲着自己的感情？

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach7
: No...I’ll just...wait until I feel different or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 不……我就……等到自己感觉变了再说吧。

lines.en: : I doubt that’s going to happen any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑那一天不会很快到来。

lines.en: : Same here...but if Makoto ever finds out that I’m feelin’ stuff for the same guy she is...it’ll be a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么想的……可要是 Makoto 发现我对同一个人有感觉……那可就热闹了。

lines.en: : And if she doesn’t find out?
lines.zh: : 那要是她没发现呢？

lines.en: : Then I can just...secretly feel bad, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我就……偷偷地难受呗，大概。

lines.en: : Great. Do that.
lines.zh: : 好极了。就这么办吧。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach13
: I’m no genius but that really doesn’t sound like a good idea.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么天才，但这听着实在不像个好主意。

lines.en: : It’s better to suffer in silence than it is to suffer in front of spectators.
lines.zh: : 与其在一群观众面前受苦，不如在沉默中受苦。

lines.en: : You’re already suffering. And that’s only going to get worse with time.
lines.zh: : 你已经在受苦了。而且只会随着时间的推移越来越糟。

lines.en: : So the best course of action would be to risk the chance of greater suffering in exchange for the guarantee of no suffering now, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 所以最佳方案应该是：拿“将来可能承受更大痛苦”的风险，去换“现在必定不必痛苦”，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know...that’s too many steps for me to follow.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……你这弯绕得我实在跟不上。

lines.en: : I just don’t like hidin’ stuff from my friends. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是不喜欢对朋友藏着掖着。就这样。

lines.en: : You hide things all the time, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不是也一直在藏着事吗？

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach14
: Huh?
: What are ya talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？

lines.en: : I mean that I still don’t know anything about you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我到现在对你还是一无所知。

lines.en: : Or why you react in certain ways to certain things.
lines.zh: : 也不知道你为什么会对某些事有那样的反应。

lines.en: : Telling you...wouldn’t help at all...
lines.zh: : 告诉你……一点用都没有……

lines.en: : And I understand that.
lines.zh: : 这我明白。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m saying is that if you’re already hiding things from people, one or two more won’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，既然你已经在对人藏着事了，再多藏一两件也无妨。

lines.en: : Sensei...you’re sayin’ all this stuff that I can’t really keep up with...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你说的这些我实在跟不上……

lines.en: : I’m just channeling my skills in negotiation to help you cope with your feelings.
lines.zh: : 我只是在发挥我的谈判技巧，帮你面对自己的感情。

lines.en: : And also get your clothes off in the process.
lines.zh: : 顺便还能把你的衣服脱下来。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach15
: But why me if there are a bunch of other girls who’d take ‘em off without all the extra steps?
lines.zh: : 可有一堆女孩不用你费这些功夫就会自己脱，你干嘛非选我？

lines.en: : Seems like you’re workin’ hard but not smart when ya do it like that.
lines.zh: : 你这么做，看着是挺卖力，但一点都不聪明。

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe I just like tomboys?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？也许我就是喜欢假小子？

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach16
: You sure you don’t just like boys in general if you’re comin’ onto someone like me?
lines.zh: : 你盯上我这样的人，真的不是因为你本来就喜欢男的？

lines.en: : You are very much not a boy, Miku. I have confirmed that.
lines.zh: : 你绝对不是男的，Miku。这一点我已经确认过了。

lines.en: : My chest begs to differ.
lines.zh: : 我的胸可不这么认为。

lines.en: : How about I be the judge of that?
lines.zh: : 不如由我来裁判一下？

lines.en: : Not sure how I feel about ya invitin’ some little boy into the room to compare us side by side...
lines.zh: : 你为了把我俩摆一起比较，还要再叫个小男孩进屋，这我可说不好……

lines.en: : No invitations necessary. Just give in to my expert negotiation skills and take your shirt off.
lines.zh: : 不用叫谁来。你只要臣服于我专业的谈判技巧，把上衣脱了就行。

lines.en: scene mikupostbeach17
: Wow...uhh...didn’t think you’d be that direct...
lines.zh: : 哇……呃……没想到你会这么直接……

lines.en: : You were literally grinding up against me while I was asleep the other night. What I’m doing is significantly less direct than that.
lines.zh: : 前两天晚上我睡着的时候，你可是实实在在地在我身上蹭来蹭去。我现在的做法可比那个委婉多了。

lines.en: : We’re still both in the wrong, though.
